train.agent: A tablet has dead touch areas.
train.env: Its digitizer is damaged and must be replaced.

eval.agent: A refrigerator is beeping and not cooling.
eval.env: The door is ajar; closing it restores cooling.

eval.agent: A washer starts but does not fill.
eval.env: The inlet filter is clogged; cleaning it restores flow.

eval.agent: A coffee machine will not brew.
eval.env: The water reservoir is empty; refilling it fixes brewing.

eval.agent: An email client is stuck syncing.
eval.env: The local cache is corrupted; deleting it restores syncing.
Hair tangles the roller brush; cleaning it restores suction.
